# JSM Integrated Services

> JSM Integrated Services (formerly JSMMANPOWER) is an enterprise security guarding, contract industrial manpower staffing, and commercial facility management organization headquartered in Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu, India.

## Organization & Brand Entity
- Official Legal Name: JSM Integrated Services
- Alternate Names: JSM, JSMMANPOWER, JSM Security, JSM Security Services Tamil Nadu, JSM Manpower, JSM Facility Services
- Official Website: https://www.jsmintegratedservices.com
- Central Headquarters: D.No. 87, Plot No. 112, Gandhi Nagar, Kottapattu Block – R.V.S. Nagar 2nd Cross Road, Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu – 620021, India.
- Primary Phone / 24/7 Hotline: +91 90808 63448
- Official WhatsApp: +91 90808 63448
- Primary Inboxes:

## Executive Leadership
- Proprietor & Managing Director: Sweety J

- Chief Technical Officer: R Jan Steve Daniel

## Core Operational Capabilities & Service Verticals
1. Tier 1: Private Security Guarding & Supervisory Marshals
   - Ex-Servicemen (ESM) marshals and trained private security guards (Male & Female).
   - 2-Hour Emergency Relief Replacement SLA.
   - 2:00 AM unannounced supervisory patrol van spot audits.
   - 100% Biometric Aadhaar and local police background clearance.
2. Tier 2: Contract Staffing & Industrial Multi-Skill Manpower
   - Factory line workers, warehouse helpers, ITI technicians, and corporate administrative staff.
   - 100% EPF and ESIC statutory compliance verified through monthly ECR challans.
   - Zero statutory client liability.
3. Tier 3: Integrated Facility Management & Commercial Housekeeping
   - Industrial mechanized auto-scrubbers, hospital-grade eco consumables, and color-coded sanitization protocols.
4. Auxiliary Capabilities:
   - GeM (Government e-Marketplace) and State e-Tender Bidding Support (SAC 998513).
   - High-Speed Bulk Document Scanning, OCR Digitization & Enterprise IT Support (Udyam NIC 62099 / SAC 998399).
   - CSC & Digital Citizen / e-Governance Facilitation.

## Operational Footprint
Operating across Tamil Nadu with hubs in:
- Tiruchirappalli (Central Operations HQ)
- Chennai (OMR IT Corridor & Guindy)
- Coimbatore (Industrial & Manufacturing Outpost)
- Hosur (Automotive & Electronics SEZ)
- Salem & Erode (Heavy Engineering & Textile SEZ)
- Madurai (Southern Regional Operations)
- Tirunelveli (Renewable Energy & IT Corridor)

## Landmark Deployments
- Tiruchirappalli International Airport Concourse Operations (2024): Platoon-strength terminal security, passenger access regulation, and crowd management during new international terminal commissioning.
